CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "prayer_log" ("date" TEXT NOT NULL, "prayer" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("date", "prayer"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "qada_entries" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "prayer" TEXT NOT NULL, "missed_on" TEXT NULL, "made_up_at" INTEGER NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "azkar_counts" ("set_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "day" TEXT NOT NULL, "zikr" TEXT NOT NULL, "count" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("set_id", "day", "zikr"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "saved_duas" ("dua" TEXT NOT NULL, "saved_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("dua"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "quran_categories" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NULL, "color" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "quran_bookmarks" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "surah" INTEGER NULL, "ayah" INTEGER NULL, "page" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("page" BETWEEN 1 AND 604), "name" TEXT NULL, "category" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "quran_notes" ("surah" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ayah" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL, "highlight" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("highlight" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("surah", "ayah"), CHECK (length(trim(note)) > 0 OR highlight));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "quran_searches" ("query" TEXT NOT NULL, "searched_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("query"));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX qada_day ON qada_entries (missed_on, prayer)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX quran_bookmark_ayah ON quran_bookmarks (surah, ayah)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX quran_bookmark_page ON quran_bookmarks (page) WHERE surah IS NULL
